test_runs.selector: All service methods, exact MCP/SDK source references, fail-closed drift, and MCP construction receipt
negative_cases: An unclassified public service method fails closed.
The internal HIL decision core cannot appear in MCP or SDK route references.
MCP construction exposes a bounded sealed review without adding a tool.

test_runs.selector: Service route, SDK handler, MCP inventory/catalog, packaged-skill catalog, and SDK public-arm integration
negative_cases: Service review cannot change native tool inventory or annotations.
Service classification cannot regress SDK handler or packaged-skill catalog identity.

test_runs.selector: Non-approval pointer preservation and exact case-sensitive Fuse approval
negative_cases: Non-promotion HIL outcomes cannot advance the pointer.
Promotion cannot bypass exact case-sensitive APPROVE through Fuse.

test_runs.selector: Python lint, compile, JSON, and whitespace validation
test_runs.command: .venv/Scripts/python.exe -m ruff check; py_compile; json.tool; git diff --check
negative_cases: Malformed Python, receipt JSON, or whitespace cannot pass.
No Git, install, helper, tunnel, live candidate, live HIL, pointer, or root-spawned subagent action is included.

limitations: Row221 owns skill-to-MCP dependency metadata and workflow routing.
The separate stale hook-package matrix count remains visible for a later public-surface correction.
Installed-package parity remains at the governed release boundary.
